HRSM 101.description: Exploration of career pathway planning essentials in the in the hospitality, tourism, retail, sport, and entertainment management industries.
HRSM 101.subject: HRSM
HRSM 101.title: HRSM Professional Development Career Exploration Seminar

HRSM 201.description: Strategies, tactics, and requisite skills for career success in the hospitality, retail, sport, entertainment, and services management industries.
HRSM 201.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in HRSM 101, passing grade in SPTE 195, or enrollment in the BAIS-Services Management major.
HRSM 201.subject: HRSM
HRSM 201.title: HRSM Professional Development Seminar

HRSM 301.description: Advanced strategies, tactics, and requisite skills for career success in the hospitality, tourism, retail, sport and entertainment, and services management industries. Course must be taken prior to HRSM internship.
HRSM 301.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in HRSM 201.
HRSM 301.subject: HRSM
HRSM 301.title: HRSM Advanced Professional Development Seminar

HRSM 315.description: Introduction to service management principles and practices across hospitality, retail, sport, and entertainment industries, emphasizing service design, quality management, customer experience optimization, and operational excellence in experience-based businesses.
HRSM 315.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in HRSM 101.
HRSM 315.subject: HRSM
HRSM 315.title: Services Management in Hospitality, Retail, Sport and Entertainment

HRSM 389.description: Instructor-Led Education Abroad Program involving two or more HRSM-related industries (Hospitality, Tourism, Sport, Live Entertainment, Retail, and Fashion Merchandising, Event Management). Topic and location varies. May be repeated once under a different topic.
HRSM 389.subject: HRSM
HRSM 389.title: Global Learning in Hospitality, Retail, and Sport Management

HRSM 390.description: Current topics involving two or more HRSM-related industries (Hospitality, Tourism, Sport, Live Entertainment, Retail, and Fashion Merchandising, Event Management). Content varies by title. May be repeated once under a different topic.
HRSM 390.subject: HRSM
HRSM 390.title: Interdisciplinary Special Topics in HRSM

HRSM 401.description: Examination of effective techniques and practices of leadership development in the hospitality/tourism, retail and sport/entertainment industries.
HRSM 401.subject: HRSM
HRSM 401.title: Leadership Development in HRSM

HRSM 491.description: This course examines and analyzes the effectiveness and efficiency of events in Hospitality, Tourism, Sport, Entertainment and Fashion and Retail Management industries. Event production, evaluation, and analysis will be conducted. Detailed activities involved in event production, evaluation, and analysis will be discussed and implemented.
HRSM 491.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in HRTM 364, and SPTE 203, and RETL 362.
HRSM 491.subject: HRSM
HRSM 491.title: Event Production, Evaluation, and Analysis

HRSM 495.description: The internship is a supervised work experience in the student’s major area of study.
HRSM 495.subject: HRSM
HRSM 495.title: Internship

HRSM 497.description: Integration of prior academic work through the examination of problem inquiry, conduct of research, application of a solution development and the completion of a research paper.
HRSM 497.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: Senior status, and HRSM student (SPTE, HTMT, RETL, or BAIS).
HRSM 497.subject: HRSM
HRSM 497.title: Senior Seminar

HRSM 700.description: This course introduces the basic knowledge of quantitative concepts, principles, and methods necessary for scientific investigation of research problems related to hospitality, retail, and sport management.
HRSM 700.subject: HRSM
HRSM 700.title: Quantitative Methods in HRSM

HRSM 787.description: This is an interdisciplinary learning experience where students apply major specific constructs and current trends in hospitality, retail, sport and technology management in a study abroad context. Students will visit destinations and venues where they will interact with on site management. This course is for HRSM graduate students only and requires permission of the departmental graduate director. This course may be repeated twice for credit.
HRSM 787.subject: HRSM
HRSM 787.title: Global Seminar in Hospitality, Retail, Sport Technology Management

HRSM 788.description: The course is structured to help students apply business research methods in the field of hospitality/tourism, retail, and sport management. This course will provide the student with an understanding of the process and the tools to support business problem identification, research design, information/data collection, data analytics, result visualization, and managerial decision-making of business cases.
HRSM 788.subject: HRSM
HRSM 788.title: Business Research and Analytics in Hospitality, Retail and Sports Management

HRSM 795.description: Work experience and participation in management decision-making in a hospitality/tourism, retail, or sport/entertainment business environment. Positions assigned on an individual basis with emphasis on oral and written communication skills, planning, and problem solving.
HRSM 795.subject: HRSM
HRSM 795.title: Field Project in Hospitality, Retail, and Sport Management

HRSM 888.description: The principles of research design, focusing on the application of these principles as they apply to sport and entertainment, hospitality, and/or tourism management.
HRSM 888.subject: HRSM
HRSM 888.title: Research Design in Hospitality, Retail, and Sport Management
